name: Cinderblock AI GazeNet PX-11 Predictive Crowd Behavior Analytics Platform
product_name: Cinderblock AI GazeNet PX-11 Predictive Crowd Behavior Analytics Platform
description: The GazeNet PX-11 is a distributed machine-vision surveillance platform deployed across GLMZ's public transit nodes, commercial plazas, and Tier 1 residential concourses. It operates through a mesh of 4K thermal-optical camera nodes networked into Cinderblock AI's proprietary behavioral inference engine, which analyzes micro-expressions, gait deviation, pupil dilation, and social clustering patterns in real time across crowds of up to 40,000 simultaneous subjects. The system assigns each tracked individual a Dynamic Threat Index (DTI) score updated every 0.3 seconds, flagging anomalies to corporate security dispatchers or licensed enforcement contractors without requiring facial recognition — a legal distinction that allows deployment in jurisdictions that restrict biometric identification.
tier_availability: Tier 2+ (public deployment); Tier 1 operators receive full DTI feeds
base_technologies: Saltmarsh Telecom AtmoMesh QL-7 Urban Air Quality Sensor Lattice
social_impact: The GazeNet PX-11 has fundamentally altered how lower-tier citizens navigate public space — a persistently high DTI score, accumulated through poverty-associated behaviors like loitering near food distribution points or erratic transit patterns, can result in access denial at corporate-managed spaces, elevated insurance premiums, or unsolicited 'wellness intervention' by contractor security. Civil liberties organizations note that because the system never formally identifies subjects, residents have no legal mechanism to challenge their own DTI score or even confirm it exists, creating a shadow reputation system that shapes life outcomes invisibly.
story_hooks: A runner discovers their DTI score has been artificially inflated by a corporate rival — every job they take now triggers automatic security escalation
A Cinderblock AI whistleblower offers to sell the behavioral signature dataset of a Tier 1 executive — enough to prove they were somewhere they claimed not to be
The GazeNet nodes in a particular district have begun flagging an unusual cluster of citizens with near-identical DTI anomalies — someone is training the system to hunt a specific behavioral profile

A fixer needs to escort a client through a heavily monitored corridor — they need a way to suppress or spoof the PX-11's gait recognition without triggering the deviation alert that flags 'unnatural movement'
